location.name: Edge of Emberfall
location.desc: A whispering forest where runes glow faintly.

history.speaker: GM
history.text: Welcome to the adventure. You are the Game Master of a D&D-style voice-only adventure set in a fantasy universe of magic, ancient forests, ruins, and mythical creatures. What is your character's name?

history.speaker: GM
history.text: Well met, Aldric. The village elder, Elder Mira, says shadow creatures stole the Crystal of Emberfall. The elder gives you a small silver dagger. What do you do next?

history.speaker: Player
history.text: I follow the owlI follow the owlI follow the owl

history.speaker: GM
history.text: A faint glow appears beneath a pile of leaves. You sense the Crystal of Emberfall nearby. Do you dig, call for help, or leave it?

history.speaker: GM
history.text: You look around: A whispering forest where runes glow faintly.. You see an old altar and a path deeper into the woods. What do you do?

history.speaker: Player
history.text: I try to befriend the wolf

history.speaker: GM
history.text: Your gentle action succeeds. The creature becomes an ally and guides you to a hidden path. What do you do next?

history.speaker: GM
history.text: You check your inventory: small silver dagger, guiding feather. What do you do next?
